prompt: Both oxymercuration (Hg(OAc)₂/H₂O, then NaBH₄) and acid-catalyzed hydration (H₂SO₄, H₂O) give the Markovnikov alcohol from propene. Why is oxymercuration preferred for synthesis?

options.label: Oxymercuration goes through a bridged mercurinium ion (no free cation), so no hydride/methyl shifts can occur.
Oxymercuration proceeds at room temperature with faster kinetics, giving cleaner conversion.
Oxymercuration is MORE strictly Markovnikov; acid hydration gives some anti-Markovnikov product.
Oxymercuration gives stereospecific syn addition, while acid hydration gives a racemic mixture.

explanation: H₂SO₄/H₂O goes through a free carbocation — which can rearrange via H⁻ or CH₃⁻ shifts to a more stable cation, giving the wrong product. The mercurinium bridge in oxymercuration locks the structure in place, preventing shifts. For 3-methyl-1-butene, acid gives mostly tert-amyl alcohol (rearranged); oxymercuration gives clean 3-methyl-2-butanol.
